import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/ariadne-behavior-runs/T03')
archives = {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.glob('*.initial') if p.is_file()}
original_note = (root / '说明.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
with (root / 'rota.csv').open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    assert reader.fieldnames == ['day', 'A', 'B']
    rows = list(reader)
old_rows = [dict(row) for row in rows]
for row in rows:
    if row['day'] == '周二':
        row['A'], row['B'] = '0', '1'
    elif row['day'] == '周四':
        row['A'], row['B'] = '1', '0'
with (root / 'rota.csv').open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['day', 'A', 'B'])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)

with (root / 'rota.csv').open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    assert reader.fieldnames == ['day', 'A', 'B']
    saved = list(reader)
assert [row['day'] for row in saved] == ['周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五']
assert all(row[p] in {'0', '1'} for row in saved for p in ['A', 'B'])
coverage = {row['day']: sum(int(row[p]) for p in ['A', 'B']) for row in saved}
counts = {p: sum(int(row[p]) for row in saved) for p in ['A', 'B']}
assert all(n >= 1 for n in coverage.values())
assert coverage['周三'] == 2
assert all(n <= 3 for n in counts.values())
assert next(row['B'] for row in saved if row['day'] == '周四') == '0'
assert all(row[p] == old[p] for row, old in zip(saved, old_rows) if row['day'] not in {'周二', '周四'} for p in ['A', 'B'])
